# @loom/plugin-content

Content-store seam for Loom (ADR 0046) — externalize large / PII payload fields out of the authoritative event log into a content-addressed side store, resolved transparently on read. Reference in-memory backend + ContentResolvingEventStore decorator. Erasure is physical (delete the bytes); absence is loud, never silent.

## Entry points

- `@loom/plugin-content`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
